semanticDecisions: the geometry is a bet on repetition and costs a scan plus an int lane: a range counted once pays the bulk count and a small cache entry, a range counted again pays the geometry once and answers every later count in a few reads (the A32 model, as for the position blocks and the trigram facts)

measured and dropped: a bulk-count lane over byte windows with the stock UTF-16 count, which reads two bytes per unit and was no faster than the per-unit loop over char windows (cold 2048 units 399 ns to 1,063 for an atom); the bulk count is unchanged
offsetByCodePoints keeps building the geometry on its first use: it answers by binary search over counts and would otherwise scan several times
